text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Instead of saying "improve the website," a SMART goal would be "redesign the homepage by June 30." It also helps to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the final products or results you must hand in. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on these goals from the start. When everyone shares the same expectations, the project is much more likely to run smoothly and achieve the desired results.
